Enum EnumTypeCommands

  • Object
    • Enum<EnumTypeCommands>
      • EnumTypeCommands
  • All Implemented Interfaces:
    AbasEnum, AbasType, Serializable, Cloneable, Comparable<EnumTypeCommands>

    public enum EnumTypeCommands
extends Enum<EnumTypeCommands>
implements AbasEnum
    This java enum represents the standard abas erp enumeration Type commands (A198).
    It is independent from a specific ERP client.
